raceTips.comment: Evaporate is the class horse who ran very well with excuses first up behind Cosmic Crusader. He has an excellent second up record. Pinstriped is capable on his day and it was an improved run last time, while Zambardo has upside and can run well fresh in this distance range. Ten Commandments is in super form and will be suited if the rain arrives.
